WELCOME TO EIFA
IN THE HEART OF LONDON
Junior EIFA (from 2 to 11)
Middle EIFA (from 12 to 14)
Welcome to EIFA
EIFA International School (“EIFA”) is an independent, co-ed, secular and international school, located in Marylebone, Central London. EIFA provides bilingual education in French and English to children aged 2 to 14 years old. From Nursery to Year 9, the school creatively combines the rigorous approach of the French curriculum with the breadth, creativity, and excitement of the English curriculum.
The School was rated “GOOD” at the last Ofsted Inspection, in June 2024. The following are excerpts from the report:
“The school is a happy, welcoming, and inclusive community where aspirations for pupils are high. Pupils value all that they learn from their peers about their different cultures that they bring from a wide range of countries. They feel that this diversity enriches their lives and helps them to gain a global perspective of modern life. Pupils feel safe and well cared for.”
“The school strives to ensure that all pupils, including those with special educational needs and/or disabilities (SEND), achieve highly. Right from the start of Early Years, the school ensures that pupils are immersed in both French and English. Pupils enjoy much success in the ambitious programmes of study. They also gain strong proficiency in both languages.”
“Pupils enjoy very strong working relationships with adults and with each other. There is a strong ambience of respect and valuing everyone for who they are. This leads to a harmonious and purposeful learning and social environment.“
Why Choose EIFA?
Bilingual French/English curriculum
Average of 15 pupils per class
Multicultural environment 30 nationalities represented
150 pupilsFrom Pre-Nursery to Year 9
Central London location with wide-ranging extracurricular activities
Happy, welcoming, and inclusive community
Gallery
What our Parents say
"EIFA International School is a safe heaven for my eleven and nine year old daughters who moved to London in 2026. I was looking for a French school and decided to enroll them in this school as opposed to other larger French schools, and it was the best decision I made: they got personalised attention by the teachers, and were warmly welcomed by the EIFA community. Parents are very involved in the day to day activities of the children and regularly meet up in parks, coffee get together, and year end parties. The school not only offers excellent academic learning experience but also organises so much extracurricular activities such as visiting museums, organising residential trips, and focusing on lots of sports and outdoor activities. This school is highly recommended to international students and locals alike."
"Excellent school combining high academic level with warm and caring environment. The staff is always listening to the pupils and parents, working with them as and when needed.The academic level of the school is all the more impressive that, contrary to other similar schools, EIFA does not have an entry selection and even welcomes children who do not speak English or French when they join. The progress these children do is just incredible and pupils go from one language to another effortlessly.But most importantly, having 3 children at the school, in Nursery, Year 1 and Year 3, with very different characters, passions and academic profiles, they are all 3 thriving both on a personal level and academic, thanks to the high standards of the school and the individual approach of the staff who knows how to adapt to each child."
As a parent , I cannot recommend Eifa enough. Academic wise, they are extraordinary. When our child joined Eifa, he did not know a single word of French. After one year, thanks to excellent teachers and their innovative program, he has now mastered the language perfectly as a native speaker. The curriculum is delivered in English and French daily, with extra classes of German/ Spanish and Latin. Enrichment sessions are a great occasion for students to challenge themselves in different subjects like archaeology, coding , journalism and many more. The environment is nurturing and extra positive. They invest a lot in empathy and pastoral care. Students feel really part of a big family. Classes are small: this allows teachers to support on daily basis every single student, leaving none behind, while students work together closely creating extraordinary bonds of true friendship. The parents’ association works closely with the school to welcome new families , creating a great sense of community while organizing charity events as well as cultural initiatives. Eifa is a true bilingual school with great attention to the well being of every single child. A true international school were everyone feels welcome for his unique background .
"EIFA International School's bilingual, positive and "growth-mindset" fostering approach to education contributes to a unique learning experience and environment, nurturing children on all aspects - from literacy and numeracy to sports, arts and music - on both the academic and the personal development front.
Thanks to its excellent quality teachers and staff, an impressively high staff-to-children ratio, children develop this rare ability to explore, question, discern, think outside the box and create by themselves - well beyond bluntly memorising and reproducing text books - all with passion and confidence. In turn, as they feel safe and cared for, children learn seamlessly, with pleasure.
"Being born in London and having grown up throughout the English primary school system (state school), going to EIFA was an amazing transition to secondary for our daughter in September 2020.
Until then, we had managed her learning of the French language via Saturday schools, private classes and, later on, CNED tuition, so joining EIFA then was a step up into a fully integrated bilingual education.
The fact that kids have uneven level of French or English was handled well by the school and never at the expense of academic progress. In hindsight, probably an asset to be able to collaborate with diverse profiles.
EIFA's student-centred approach helped our older son who had suffered greatly in the rigid and punitive French school system. He has now left EIFA and is a confident student performing well academically in his new high school. Our second son is still in EIFA, and the school environment has also suited him. While there were initial concerns about the small class sizes in Middle School, this has posed no issues for him. It is a luxury to have this level of support compared to many schools charging the same tuition but cramming 25-30 students in one classroom. The school also applies an interdisciplinary approach to their courses which results in very well-rounded students who know information beyond the basic core curriculum (politics, human rights, geography, journalism, coding, etc.). Lastly, the PTA is very active at EIFA. They organize parties, talks, and educational seminars for the kids and parents which is not very common in other schools.

Mission and Values
At EIFA, our community is guided by five core values: curiosity, determination, cooperation, respect, and responsibility. These principles shape our bilingual learning environment and support both academic excellence and personal growth. They help our pupils become confident, thoughtful, and resilient individuals, ready to thrive in a global world.
CuriosityWe encourage pupils to ask questions, explore ideas, and develop a genuine love of learning. Curiosity drives academic engagement across both French and English, helping pupils deepen their understanding of the world and think independently.
DeterminationWe support pupils in developing perseverance and resilience when facing challenges. Whether in their studies or personal growth, pupils are encouraged to keep going, learn from mistakes, and build confidence through effort.
CooperationLearning at EIFA is rooted in collaboration. Pupils work together across languages and cultures, learning to listen, share ideas, and contribute positively to group work and the wider school community.
RespectWe foster an inclusive environment where every member of the community is valued. Pupils are encouraged to show respect for themselves and others, as well as consider different perspectives, helping to create a safe and supportive atmosphere.
ResponsibilityWe help pupils take ownership of their actions, learning, and behaviour. Responsibility is developed through independence, accountability, and a growing understanding of how their choices impact others and their learning journey.

Mission et Valeurs
À l’EIFA, notre communauté s’appuie sur cinq valeurs fondamentales : la curiosité, la détermination, la coopération, le respect et la responsabilité. Ces principes façonnent notre environnement d’apprentissage bilingue et favorisent à la fois l’excellence académique et l’épanouissement personnel. Ils aident nos élèves à devenir des individus confiants, réfléchis et résilients, prêts à s’épanouir dans un monde globalisé.
Nous encourageons les élèves à poser des questions, explorer de nouvelles idées et développer un véritable goût pour l’apprentissage. La curiosité stimule l’engagement scolaire en français comme en anglais, permettant aux élèves d’approfondir leur compréhension du monde et de développer leur esprit critique et leur capacité à penser par eux-mêmes.
Nous accompagnons les élèves dans le développement de leur persévérance et de leur résilience face aux défis. Que ce soit dans leurs études ou dans leur vie personnel, ils sont encouragés à poursuivre leurs efforts, à apprendre de leurs erreurs et à gagner en confiance grâce à leur travail et à leur engagement.
L’apprentissage à l’EIFA repose sur la collaboration. Les élèves travaillent ensemble au-delà des langues et des cultures, apprenant à écouter les autres, à partager leurs idées et à contribuer positivement aux projets collectifs ainsi qu’à la vie de l’école.
Nous cultivons un environnement inclusif où chaque membre de la communauté est valorisé. Les élèves sont encouragés à faire preuve de respect envers eux-mêmes et envers les autres, tout en considérant différents points de vue. Cela contribue à créer un climat de confiance, bienveillant et propice à l’apprentissage.
Nous aidons les élèves à prendre conscience de leurs actions, de leurs apprentissages et de leur comportement. Le sens des responsabilités se développe à travers l’autonomie, la capacité à rendre compte de ses choix et une compréhension grandissante de l’impact de ceux-ci sur les autres et sur leur propre parcours d’apprentissage.

Welcome!
We are delighted to welcome you to EIFA, our international school in Marylebone, Central London.
EIFA is a full-time bilingual French and English School following the French National curriculum taught both in English and French by native speakers.
Our aim is to provide our pupils with solid academic foundations both in French and English and encourage them to fulfil their potential in a multicultural environment. We make sure our pupils are safe, happy and protected from harm. We encourage them to take initiatives, to open their minds to different cultures and traditions, as well as to respect and promote the British and French values.
Our staff are enthusiastic and dedicated to helping the children in their development. We strongly believe that every child can learn and progress if they have the right tools and time devoted to them. We therefore adapt the teaching to each of them according to their needs, in a way that will always encourage their self-confidence and growth. .
We look forward to meeting you and your children and to welcoming you to our school.
Stéphane Kuhn Head of School

Bienvenue!
Nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir à l’EIFA, notre école internationale à Marylebone, au coeur de Londres. L’EIFA est une école bilingue à parité horaire français-anglais qui suit le programme du Ministère de l’education nationale et dont les enseignants sont tous des locuteurs natifs.
Notre objectif est de fournir à nos élèves des bases académiques solides à la fois en français et en anglais et de les encourager à réaliser leur potentiel dans un environnement multiculturel. Nous veillons à ce que nos élèves évoluent dans un environnement bienveillant et protecteur. Nous les encourageons à prendre des initiatives, à ouvrir leur esprit à différentes cultures et traditions, ainsi qu’à respecter et promouvoir les valeurs britanniques et françaises.
Nous croyons fermement que chaque enfant peut apprendre et progresser s’il dispose des bons outils et du temps nécessaire. Nous adaptons donc l’enseignement à chacun d’entre eux selon leurs besoins, de manière à toujours encourager leur confiance et leur développement.
Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer, vous et vos enfants, et de vous accueillir dans notre établissement.

EIFA Parents
EIFA Parents is the official Association of Parents of EIFA International School. We depend on parent volunteers and financial contributions for intra and extracurricular activities that promote creativity and foster a love of learning outside of activities provided by the school. We deliver a number of events and experiences for the children and raise money for charity; helping our children to learn to give back to the community.
An active well-functioning Parents Association is a sign of a healthy school with engaged parents. The Good Schools Guide specifically notes the contribution of EIFA Parents to EIFA school life.
EIFA Parents Board Members
To raise funds for projects and equipment to benefit the School community as a whole. To organise social events to enable School parents to meet and get to know each other, such as coffee mornings, summer parties and sports day picnics. To represent the views of parents to the Head of School and the School’s Board of Directors. Parents of children in the School are entitled to attend meetings and are encouraged to participate in the organisation of events throughout the school year.
At the beginning of each school year, the Head of School and EIFA Parents invite all parents to attend an informal meeting where parents will be asked if one of them would like to be a class representative for their child’s class. At EIFA we regard the cooperation with parents as of the utmost importance, class reps thus have a leading role in our school community.
EIFA Parents meet once each term with the Head of School to discuss items of general parental concern. Prior to each meeting an invitation will be issued to parents to submit any questions or issues which they may have. EIFA Parents and the Head of School may also discuss fundraising events and items that the School may particularly need in the upcoming year.
For the latest news on EIFA Parents events, view the School Calendar. The emphasis is on fun, friendliness and maximum participation – everyone is welcome! Please also look out for information posted on the noticeboard at the main entrance of the School.
A contribution of £50 per child is kindly requested to support the Parents’ Association. These fees enable us to organise events, fund initiatives, and strengthen our school community.
Visit EIFA Parents’ website: https://web.classlist.com/eifaparents

Wraparound Care
In addition to its primary function of welcoming and supervising children in the absence of parents, the wraparound care offers a variety of activities aimed at fostering the cognitive, psychomotor, and emotional development of children. Children find themselves in an educational environment in complete safety. Supervised and guided by the educational team, they can freely participate in structured or unstructured activities (games, crafts, library, cinema, etc.). The wraparound care is available to all school children every afternoon of the week after school.
Hours: from 15:30 to 17:00
The wraparound care is payable per trimester (September – December – March) in advance and is non-refundable, even if the child does not attend. Any session started is due. Payment must be made exclusively through the Parentpay payment site. In case of non-payment, the child will not be accepted at the wraparound care.

Our story
EIFA opened its doors in January 2013. The vision was of a bilingual school, but one that would creatively combine the French and the English curricula.
Truly bilingual in every aspect, from the start right up to Year 9, EIFA is unique in its scope, its ambition and its relevance to today’s global child.
EIFA owes its wonderful school building to the vision and commitment of the Howard de Walden Estate. We are situated at 36 Portland Place, a wonderful period property and a wonderful environment for teaching and learning.

Staff recruitment at EIFA
EIFA International School was established in order to serve the educational needs of children from the international and local communities in London. Our aim is to achieve high academic standards, by incorporating internationally recognised educational principles and practices. We foster open-minded and flexible citizens of the world, who will find themselves at home in more than one culture, communicate in more than one language, understand the views of others and how these are shaped, and mix with people of a variety of backgrounds and cultures.
Working as part of the EIFA team is interesting, rewarding and a unique experience. We operate in an extremely competitive marketplace and depend on the skills of our team members to achieve our objectives and to uphold our reputation for the quality of our educational services. We are committed to helping our staff to perform well in their present jobs and we will encourage, support and develop all who demonstrate the ability and desire to succeed and advance within our School. Staff wellbeing is important to us and our team members enjoy the community spirit of working here. If you feel you may be interested in a position here at EIFA, please submit your CV and a covering letter, including information about the type of role you are looking for.

After School Clubs and Activities
Different weekly after school clubs are offered in small groups of students. Activities range from art, drama, to sport and music. Members of the teaching staff, educators or professional coaches will operate the After-school clubs. Details of clubs on offer will be provided at the beginning of each term.
Afternoon: From 15.30 to 17:00 session.
Fees are payable in advance via Parentpay before beginning of each term. Fees for clubs are non-refundable. A pupil may be admitted to an After-school club when the fee is paid in full. Full fee is charged, whether or not a pupil attended all sessions.
